rules: Retain every original collected case and numerical parameter.
Keep original numerical tolerances and reference assets unchanged.
A mocked collaborator must have a separately retained real integration contract.
Fresh-import cases remain responsible for importer construction; restored scenes exercise downstream consumers.
A complete matched run, including cold artifact construction, must satisfy the runtime target.

fixture_contracts.mutable: Function or module lease with independently copied DNA, output paths and reopened RNA

fixture_contracts.shared: Scene within a module whose cases reset their evaluated pose
fixture_contracts.mutable: No RNA or writable DNA survives module teardown
checks: Unchanged Maya and Unreal numerical pose matrices

fixture_contracts.shared: Paths and parsed reference data only

checks: Original bone, mesh, normal, skin and LOD assertion matrices

checks: Original import and bake action assertions in shuffled order

checks: All original native baking and evaluation ownership cases

fixture_contracts.shared: Pristine real head-only DNA and scene

fixture_contracts.mutable: Own DNA files and live scene; empty-destination cases do not build an unused character
checks: All six test_reference_blend_file combinations, including reload, native animation and source file protection

All original runtime retention, shape-import finalization and combined swing/twist cases

fixture_contracts.shared: All original native controls, joint definitions, solvers and LODs; three vertices per mesh and one original mapped shape channel
fixture_contracts.mutable: Real import, native bindings, mesh/key edits, commit/revert, save/load and backups. Scene bone subset keeps observed outputs, every native quaternion input, head attachment and ancestors.
checks: Original lifecycle, retention, backup, visibility and editor transaction assertions
Original full geometry, UV, long-key, calf-back-90 deformation, native graph and export/calibration anchors remain

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Merged raw jaw/rest editing, publication retry, RBF editing and export presentation
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Thirteen editor/export cases repeated the scene merge as preparation for testing an already merged surface.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: The real profile builder constructs that surface once; each case acquires private files and scene state, asserts merged presentation, and retains every original editor, geometry, publication and identity assertion.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Real merge and split were performed to create paired backup records.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Real backup tracking creates paired operation records around small file changes; retention checks pairing and distinct IDs directly.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Every routing combination repeated full geometry export and checked joint count and last joint name.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Real exporter construction and the Blender operator run against an autospecced run boundary; assertions cover exact exporter class, selected component, source path, destination name and texture exclusion.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Full DNA imports provided two paths to the output-folder validator.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Registered minimal RNA and real temporary paths exercise the same validator and exception assertion.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: An exact directory listing rejected unrelated local measurement tools.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Required benchmark files remain required; AST inspection rejects transitive CI dependencies on local probe tools.
retained_integration: Existing CI benchmark invocation and subprocess boundaries

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Each parameter called the merge operator as a setup precondition.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: The profile builder calls and asserts the real merge once; each lease asserts its requested merged state before the unchanged import and native-output checks.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Expected an obsolete confirmation sentence, failing on the original baseline.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Asserts the existing production confirmation sentence with the same exact generated count; read-only file and key checks remain unchanged.

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Four 85-frame timing loops verified binding count but never asserted frame outputs or a runtime threshold.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: All 42 original targets and four name-mode transitions remain. Three distinct frame/control samples per mode compare every evaluated channel to the real SDK. Complete-suite performance is measured separately.

changed_assertion_boundaries.case: Native graph copy and equality helpers
changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Python deepcopy recursively visited every scalar; exact equality recursively revisited large equal scalar arrays.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: Trusted in-memory graphs are independently copied with pickle; scalar-list equality short-circuits in C with explicit nested-container and NaN safeguards. Exact comparisons and mismatch paths are unchanged.
retained_integration: test_graph_fixture.py ownership, tiny float differences, metadata and NaN checks
All original native graph, projection and round-trip tests

changed_assertion_boundaries.before: Every head runtime case loaded full mesh data and materials.
changed_assertion_boundaries.after: All original native joints and face-board inputs remain. Meshes are loaded only for native_shape consumers; unused materials are omitted.
retained_integration: Original full-mesh native_shape matrix and deformation assertions

fault_checks.method: In-memory AST mutation; no source-file edits
fault_checks.integration: Real per-editor failure, binding recovery and merged-surface tests remain enabled.
